hero.headline: Make BlaBliBlu
hero.description: We’ll build an army of dedicated creator accounts posting about BlaBliBlu every day — with one goal: get more people talking about the brand, remembering it, and looking for it when they’re ready to buy.

campaign.headline: An army of dedicated creator accounts.
campaign.description: We’ll work with 5–10 UGC creators who each create a new ambassador account dedicated to BlaBliBlu.
campaign.cadence: Each creator posts twice a day for 30 days across Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

goals.title: Go viral.
goals.description: Give BlaBliBlu hundreds of chances to break through.

goals.title: Be the first perfume brand they think of.
goals.description: Show up often enough to earn a place in their mind.

goals.title: Build awareness that turns into demand.
goals.description: Get more people searching for BlaBliBlu and discovering it on quick commerce.

playbook.headline: First, we figure out what your audience wants to see.
playbook.description: We’ll spend time researching BlaBliBlu’s ICP, the category, the creators they follow and the content already winning with them.

testing.headline: We’re not trying to guess what will work.
testing.description: Creators start posting twice a day.
testing.closing: We watch what gets people to stop, watch, share and talk about BlaBliBlu.

winners.headline: When something works, we don’t let it die.
winners.description: We figure out why it worked. Then we give the winning idea more creators, more variations and more distribution.
winners.statement: The goal isn’t 300 videos. It’s finding the few worth making 300 more of.

result.headline: A brand people keep seeing.
result.closing: And a repeatable organic growth channel you can keep building.
